commit.message:
Update GH actions (#8983)

Movitivated by the eMudhra incident.

There were fixes for
- pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish (fixed in #8974)
- scientific-python/upload-nightly-action (fixed in this PR)

I decided to just update everything and pin to commit shas. I ran these commands:

```
$ update-gha --update-version-with release-commit-sha
$ pre-commit run -a
```
